name: Map
description: A Map module beside Library and Develop: your geotagged photos as thumbnail pins on a basemap that follows the app theme, drag-to-geotag, a filter that narrows the Library to the map view, and overlays other extensions draw (GPX tracks with GPS Track).
author: Anthony Reimche

permissions.reason: Downloads map tiles, fonts and sprites from OpenFreeMap to draw the basemap.
